item.title: TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA TURTLES II: THE SECRET OF THE OOZE Returning To Theaters For 35th Anniversary
item.description: Following the success of last year's 35th anniversary re-release of the original live-action Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles movie, Fathom Events has announced that The Secret of the Ooze will follow suit...

item.title: Catherine O'Hara, Beloved BEETLEJUICE, HOME ALONE & THE STUDIO Star, Passes Away At Age 71
item.description: Beloved Beetlejuice, Home Alone, The Paper and The Last of Us star Catherine O'Hara has passed away at the age of 71, and tributes have been pouring in since the sad news broke...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Promo Art Reveals Best Look Yet At Robert Downey Jr. As Doctor Doom
item.description: Thanks to what appears to be an officially licensed t-shirt, we have arguably our best look yet at Robert Downey Jr. masked-up as the villainous Doctor Doom in Avengers: Doomsday...

item.title: 10 Unresolved Multiverse Saga Post-Credits Scenes Heading Into AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
item.description: Heading into Avengers: Doomsday this December, some major post-credits scene cliffhangers remain unresolved, and we're not entirely sure the ensemble plans to address them.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Leaked Story Details Reveal Possible LOKI Retcon With Steve Rogers Implications
item.description: The latest Avengers: Doomsday plot leak claims to clear up the apparent connection between Steve Rogers, Doctor Doom, and the Fantastic Four. Potential SPOILERS follow.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Promo Art And Character Bios Reveal New Story Details
item.description: Packaging for upcoming action figures based on the live-action Masters of the Universe reveals a new look at three lead characters, and offers up brief character bios.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star Ian McKellen Drops A Major SPOILER For Magneto's Return
item.description: X-Men franchise legend Ian McKellen returns as Magneto in this December's Avengers: Doomsday, and the actor appears to have just revealed a huge scene involving the Master of Magnetism.

item.title: The 2026 Remake Of The GHOST IN THE SHELL Anime Looks Great As New Trailer Drops
item.description: Science Saru has dropped the first trailer for their 2026 Ghost in the Shell anime and it looks pretty good. The anime is set to be a faithful adaptation of the Ghost in the Shell manga.

item.title: AMAZING SPIDER-MAN/VENOM: DEATH SPIRAL BODY COUNT Will Reveal Torment's Twisted Origin
item.description: This May, Amazing Spider-Man/Venom: Death Spiral Body Count by Charles Soule and Kev Walker reveals the origin of Torment, and we have a first look and details.

item.title: CAPTAIN AMERICA: BRAVE NEW WORLD's Original Post-Credits Scene Introduced Another MCU Hulk
item.description: Ghostbusters: Afterlife star Logan Kim was supposed to make a cameo appearance in Captain America: Brave New World as Amadeus Cho, but it seems he was also supposed to Hulk out.
